Name: (CP) Prettier Elliott's Cabin
Author: MarcyTheBeast
Description:
[size=5]Overview
[/size]
[list]
[*]This mod attempts to make Elliott's cabin a bit less ugly, giving him a nicer desk to write, better looking furniture and some additional decorations from the much better looking town tilesheet without making it feel out of place, and still keeping the overall rustic beach cabin vibe.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Also gives him a little table where he can eat because the poor guy doesn't even have that.
[/list]

[size=5]Compability[/size]

[list]
[*]The mod is fully recolor compatible, it only uses vanilla tilesheets. (VPR actually highly recommended)

[/list][list]
[*]Not compatible with any other mods that replace Elliott's cabin, mods that only modify certain tiles should technically work.
[/list]
[size=5]Requirements And Installation

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]This mod [u]requires[/u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]To install just unzip the archive in your mod folder and enjoy.[/size]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Prettier Elliott's Cabin
Manifest.Description: Changes the interior of Elliott's cabin to be a bit less ugly.
